tracesTo: SOW: Commissioner Desk & Weekly Content Publishing
UserFlow: Weekly Commissioner Desk → Optional Content Creation & Publishing to Feed

stories.title: Select Featured Matchup from Weekly Schedule
stories.goal: select one matchup from the current week's schedule to feature as 'Matchup of the Week'
stories.benefit: I can highlight the most interesting or competitive matchup to drive engagement
acceptanceCriteria: System displays all matchups for the selected week in selectable list format with team names and records
User can select exactly one matchup as the featured matchup per week
Selected matchup is visually highlighted with distinct styling and 'Featured' badge
System prevents publishing if no matchup is selected and section is not skipped
Previously selected matchup for the week is preserved and displayed on return to desk

stories.title: View Matchup Context and Statistics
stories.goal: see relevant team statistics and historical context when selecting a featured matchup
stories.benefit: I can make informed decisions about which matchup is most interesting to feature
acceptanceCriteria: Each matchup displays team current records (wins-losses) from external platform data
System shows team power rankings position (if available) for both teams
Matchup list displays projected or actual scores when available from platform
System highlights rivalry indicators (e.g., same division, previous playoff matchups) if data available
User can expand matchup row to see additional team statistics without leaving selection interface

stories.title: Write Matchup Hype Text
stories.goal: add compelling narrative text to build anticipation for the featured matchup
stories.benefit: I can tell the story behind the matchup and engage league members emotionally
acceptanceCriteria: System provides rich text editor for hype text with basic formatting (bold, italic, links)
Editor supports multiline input with minimum 10 characters and maximum 2000 characters
Character count indicator shows remaining characters and validates against limits
Autosave preserves hype text drafts every 30 seconds and on blur
System displays preview of how hype text will appear on matchup page and feed moment
Hype text field is required if matchup is selected; system blocks publishing if empty

stories.title: Create Structured Winner Prediction
stories.goal: predict which team will win the featured matchup with rationale
stories.benefit: I can make my official prediction and add credibility to my commissioner role
acceptanceCriteria: System provides radio button or select control to choose predicted winner from the two teams
User must select exactly one team as predicted winner before publishing
Optional 'Predicted Score' fields allow entering score predictions for both teams (integers only)
Optional 'Prediction Rationale' text field supports up to 500 characters for reasoning
Prediction data is stored structured (not free text) for later automated grading
System displays prediction prominently on matchup page with 'Commissioner Prediction' header

stories.title: Skip Matchup of the Week for Specific Weeks
stories.goal: choose not to feature a matchup for weeks where no compelling storyline exists
stories.benefit: I can avoid forced content and maintain quality when appropriate
acceptanceCriteria: System provides 'Skip Matchup of the Week' toggle checkbox at top of section
When skipped, all matchup selection and content fields are disabled and grayed out
Skipped status is saved to draft and prevents validation errors during publishing
System clearly indicates 'Skipped for this week' status with informational message
User can un-skip section and add content without affecting other published sections
No feed moment or matchup page content is created for skipped weeks

stories.title: Edit Previously Published Matchup Features
stories.goal: correct errors or update hype text/predictions after initial publication
stories.benefit: I can fix mistakes without being locked into wrong information
acceptanceCriteria: System allows editing published matchup features by creating new draft version
Draft edits are not visible to league members until explicitly republished
Republishing updates matchup page content and adds 'Updated' indicator to feed moment
System preserves original prediction for grading purposes even if updated before grading
Version history tracks all changes with timestamps and editor identification
User can revert to previous version from version history if needed

stories.title: Preview Matchup Feature Content
stories.goal: see exactly how the featured matchup will appear before publishing
stories.benefit: I can verify layout, formatting, and content accuracy before making it public
acceptanceCriteria: Preview mode renders matchup exactly as it will appear on matchup page to league members
Preview includes team names, records, hype text, prediction, and all formatting
Preview shows how feed moment will appear in newsfeed timeline with timestamp
User can toggle between edit and preview modes without losing unsaved changes
Preview mode clearly indicates 'Preview - Not Published' with visual banner

stories.title: Validate Matchup Feature Completeness
stories.goal: receive clear feedback about missing or invalid content before attempting to publish
stories.benefit: I can complete all required fields without trial-and-error publishing attempts
acceptanceCriteria: System displays validation errors inline for each incomplete or invalid field
Publish button is disabled with tooltip explaining missing requirements
Validation checks: matchup selected, hype text present and within limits, winner predicted
Error messages are specific and actionable (e.g., 'Select a featured matchup' not 'Invalid content')
Validation occurs in real-time as user completes fields, providing immediate feedback
System allows saving drafts with incomplete content but prevents publishing

stories.title: Publish Matchup Feature to Feed and Pages
stories.goal: make the featured matchup and prediction visible to all league members with single action
stories.benefit: I can efficiently share my matchup feature without manual multi-step processes
acceptanceCriteria: Publishing creates dedicated 'Matchup of the Week' feed moment in league newsfeed
Matchup page displays featured matchup section with hype text and prediction prominently
Feed moment includes team names, hype text preview (truncated if long), and link to full matchup page
Published content is immediately visible to all league members based on role permissions
System records publication timestamp and associates prediction with week for later grading
Publish operation is atomic - all updates succeed or all fail with rollback

stories.title: Grade Commissioner Prediction After Stat Corrections
stories.goal: have my winner prediction automatically graded as correct or incorrect after official results
stories.benefit: I can track my prediction accuracy over time and add credibility to future predictions
acceptanceCriteria: System automatically grades prediction after stat correction deadline passes for week
Grading compares predicted winner to actual matchup winner from platform final scores
Prediction is marked 'Correct' or 'Incorrect' with visual indicator on matchup page
System updates commissioner prediction accuracy statistics (total correct/total predictions)
Graded predictions cannot be changed retroactively but can be annotated with notes
System handles edge cases: ties (marked as incorrect), cancelled games (marked as void)

stories.title: Track Commissioner Prediction History
stories.goal: view the commissioner's past prediction accuracy and track record
stories.benefit: I can see how reliable the commissioner's predictions are over time
acceptanceCriteria: System maintains cumulative prediction record for commissioner visible on profile or stats page
Statistics display: total predictions, correct predictions, accuracy percentage, streak information
Historical view shows all past predictions with results for each week (correct/incorrect/pending)
Predictions are linked to original matchup pages for context
Statistics reset annually for redraft leagues or persist across seasons for dynasty leagues
Leaderboard comparison shows commissioner accuracy vs other predictors if applicable

stories.title: Change Featured Matchup Before Publishing
stories.goal: switch to a different featured matchup if I change my mind during draft creation
stories.benefit: I can adjust my selection without losing all my work
acceptanceCriteria: User can reselect featured matchup from schedule at any time before publishing
Changing matchup selection displays confirmation prompt warning that hype text may need updating
System preserves hype text and prediction rationale when changing matchup (not auto-cleared)
Predicted winner selection is cleared when matchup changes to prevent invalid data
Autosave captures new matchup selection immediately for draft persistence
System provides undo capability to revert to previous matchup selection within editing session
